title: Autoregressive Multimodal Anomaly Detection with Large Language Models for Microservice Systems
title_zh: 基于大语言模型的自回归多模态微服务系统异常检测

paragraphs.en: Microservice systems have become a dominant architecture for large-scale cloud applications, enabling rapid deployment and elastic scaling. However, ensuring the reliability and availability of microservice systems critically relies on effective anomaly detection, as failures and performance anomalies can quickly propagate across services and severely impact end-to-end system behavior. Existing multimodal anomaly detection approaches for microservice systems often struggle with two fundamental limitations: (i) the neglect of modality-specific characteristics in favor of cross-modality fusion, and (ii) the “identity-shortcut” problem that affects the feature reconstruction process. To address these issues, we propose LLMMAD, an autoregressive multimodal anomaly detection framework for microservice systems based on Large Language Models (LLMs). Initially, to reconcile cross-modality fusion with modality-specific preservation, LLMMAD embeds and recombines multimodal data into a unified sequence for LLM processing to model inter-modality relationships, while employing modality-wise reconstruction heads to retain modality-specific information. Subsequently, to eliminate the identity-shortcut, we implement a prediction-driven autoregressive objective, under which the model predicts future states rather than copies current inputs. Finally, we conduct extensive experiments on three real-world datasets. The results demonstrate that LLMMAD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving F1-score improvements of 3.1%, 1.4%, and 0.9%, respectively, thereby providing a more reliable solution for microservice monitoring.

paragraphs.en: Microservice architecture has emerged as a mainstream paradigm for building large-scale enterprise applications, delivering enhanced flexibility, scalability, and fault isolation compared to monolithic systems [ 1 ] . In microservice architecture, a complex application is decomposed into a set of loosely coupled, fine-grained services, each running in its own process and communicating via lightweight mechanisms such as HTTP or message queues. This design enables independent deployment, rapid iteration, and elastic scaling, enhancing its industrial applicability.

paragraphs.en: Limitation 1: Neglect of modality-specific information. Current multimodal anomaly detection approaches primarily focus on modeling either cross-modal relationships at the expense of modality-specific information. GNN-based approaches [ 15 , 9 , 16 , 8 , 11 ] learn graph representations that inherently entangle modalities, resulting in tightly coupled modality interactions. Other approaches [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 17 , 18 ] preserve separate modality embeddings but ultimately integrate them via fusion methods based on attention, wavelet or merely concatenation, still prioritizing cross-modal relationships. Consequently, these methods ignore the modeling of modality-specific information, potentially overlooking unique anomaly cues that are only evident within individual modalities.
paragraphs.zh: 局限一：忽视模态特定信息。 当前的多模态异常检测方法主要侧重于建模跨模态关系，而以牺牲模态特定信息为代价。 基于GNN的方法[15, 9, 16, 8, 11]学习到的图表示天然地将各模态纠缠在一起，导致模态交互紧密耦合。 其他方法[12, 13, 14, 17, 18]虽然保留了独立的模态嵌入，但最终仍通过基于注意力、小波或仅是简单拼接的融合方法对其进行整合，依然是优先考虑跨模态关系。 因此，这些方法忽略了对模态特定信息的建模，可能遗漏那些仅在单个模态内才能显现的独特异常线索。

paragraphs.en: Limitation 2: Susceptibility to identity-shortcut. Existing multimodal anomaly detection methods typically rely on temporal feature extractors (e.g., temporal CNNs [ 8 , 9 , 16 , 11 , 17 , 12 ] , LSTMs [ 10 , 18 ] , GRUs [ 13 , 15 ] , or self-attention [ 14 ] ) to learn temporal patterns. Among these methods, unsupervised approaches usually employ reconstruction architectures for anomaly scoring. However, reconstruction-based models [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] that utilize the aforementioned temporal feature extractors are susceptible to the “identity shortcut” problem, where the decoder reproduces the input disregarding its semantics. This problem becomes more severe in multimodal settings, as the increased complexity of multimodal data makes it easier to exploit. As a result, the model fails to produce discriminative representations for abnormal patterns, ultimately undermining the robustness and effectiveness of anomaly detection.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性2：容易受到「恒等捷径」问题的影响。 现有的多模态异常检测方法通常依赖时间特征提取器（例如时间卷积网络 [ 8 , 9 , 16 , 11 , 17 , 12 ]、LSTM [ 10 , 18 ]、GRU [ 13 , 15 ] 或自注意力机制 [ 14 ]）来学习时间模式。 在这些方法中，无监督方法通常采用重建架构进行异常评分。 然而，使用上述时间特征提取器的基于重建的模型 [ 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] 容易出现「恒等捷径」问题，即解码器无视输入的语义而直接复现输入。 该问题在多模态场景中变得更加严重，因为多模态数据复杂度的增加使其更容易被利用。 结果，模型无法为异常模式产生具有判别性的表示，最终损害了异常检测的鲁棒性和有效性。

paragraphs.en: To systematically address these identified limitations, we propose LLMMAD, an autoregressive multimodal framework that adopts Large language models (LLMs) for unsupervised anomaly detection in microservice systems. More specifically, LLMMAD converts the data of three modalities into a sequence of embeddings arranged in chronological order. After passing through a LoRA-adapted [ 23 ] LLM with parameters frozen, embedding-level predictions are obtained, and then they are reconstructed into the original modalities. LLMMAD not only analyzes cross-modality relationships through unified multimodal LLM inference, but also captures modality-specific information via modality-wise reconstruction. Additionally, LLMMAD implements a prediction-driven autoregressive learning paradigm. By leveraging the LLM’s causal masking to infer future states from cross-modal contexts, LLMMAD decouples inputs from target predictions. This mechanism inherently eliminates the identity-shortcut and enhances sensitivity to both temporal and inter-modality anomalies. In addition, LLMMAD unifies decisions from modalities through the OR-logic aggregation method, providing fine-grained anomaly detection for microservice systems.
paragraphs.zh: 为了系统地解决这些已识别的局限性，我们提出了LLMMAD，一个采用大语言模型（LLMs）在微服务系统中进行无监督异常检测的自回归多模态框架。 更具体地说，LLMMAD将三种模态的数据转换为按时间顺序排列的嵌入序列。 经过参数冻结的经LoRA适配的[23] LLM后，得到嵌入级别的预测，然后将其重构回原始模态。 LLMMAD不仅通过统一的多模态LLM推理分析跨模态关系，还通过按模态的重构捕获模态特定的信息。 此外，LLMMAD实现了一种预测驱动的自回归学习范式。 通过利用LLM的因果掩码从跨模态上下文推断未来状态，LLMMAD将输入与目标预测解耦。 该机制从本质上消除了恒等捷径，并增强了对时间异常和模态间异常的敏感性。 另外，LLMMAD通过OR逻辑聚合方法统一来自各模态的决策，为微服务系统提供细粒度的异常检测。

sents.zh: 此外，LLMMAD实现了一种预测驱动的自回归学习范式。

sents.en: By leveraging the LLM’s causal masking to infer future states from cross-modal contexts, LLMMAD decouples inputs from target predictions.
sents.zh: 通过利用LLM的因果掩码从跨模态上下文推断未来状态，LLMMAD将输入与目标预测解耦。

sents.en: This mechanism inherently eliminates the identity-shortcut and enhances sensitivity to both temporal and inter-modality anomalies.
sents.zh: 该机制从本质上消除了恒等捷径，并增强了对时间异常和模态间异常的敏感性。

sents.en: In addition, LLMMAD unifies decisions from modalities through the OR-logic aggregation method, providing fine-grained anomaly detection for microservice systems.
sents.zh: 另外，LLMMAD通过OR逻辑聚合方法统一来自各模态的决策，为微服务系统提供细粒度的异常检测。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we provide an overview of previous works and discuss their limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们对以往的研究工作进行概述，并讨论其局限性。

paragraphs.en: Cross-modality knowledge transfer denotes the process of aligning non-textual modalities into a language representation space. The knowledge learned from pretraining is shared to jointly model heterogeneous modalities and their interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 跨模态知识迁移是指将非文本模态对齐到语言表示空间中的过程。 从预训练中学习到的知识被共享，用于联合建模异构模态及其交互。

sents.en: Cross-modality knowledge transfer denotes the process of aligning non-textual modalities into a language representation space.
sents.zh: 跨模态知识迁移是指将非文本模态对齐到语言表示空间中的过程。

sents.en: The knowledge learned from pretraining is shared to jointly model heterogeneous modalities and their interactions.
sents.zh: 从预训练中学习到的知识被共享，用于联合建模异构模态及其交互。

paragraphs.en: Recent studies have started to investigate whether LLMs can serve as a general backbone for cross-modal modeling of non-textual data. One-Fits-All [ 24 ] extends this idea to time series data by leveraging frozen pretrained transformers to capture complex patterns in time series analysis. OneLLM [ 25 ] further establishes a unified framework that aligns eight heterogeneous modalities into a language representation space through a universal projection module and a progressive alignment pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 近期研究已开始探讨大语言模型能否作为通用骨干网络，用于非文本数据的跨模态建模。 One-Fits-All [ 24 ] 将这一思想扩展到时间序列数据，利用冻结的预训练 Transformer 来捕捉时间序列分析中的复杂模式。 OneLLM [ 25 ] 进一步建立了一个统一框架，通过通用投影模块和渐进式对齐流程，将八种异构模态对齐到语言表示空间中。

paragraphs.en: To the best of our knowledge, existing studies have not yet explored transforming multiple heterogeneous modalities in microservice systems into a unified language representation through cross-modal transfer. More importantly, leveraging LLMs for cross-modal transformation enables heterogeneous metrics, logs, and traces to be mapped into a shared sequential representation space with strong semantic and structural priors. This is crucial for modeling complex cross-modal dependencies and the downstream anomaly detection task.
paragraphs.zh: 据我们所知，现有研究尚未探索通过跨模态转换将微服务系统中的多种异构模态转换为统一的语言表示。 更重要的是，利用大语言模型进行跨模态转换，能够将异构的指标、日志和轨迹映射到一个具有强语义和结构先验的共享序列表示空间中。 这对于建模复杂的跨模态依赖关系以及下游的异常检测任务至关重要。

sents.en: To the best of our knowledge, existing studies have not yet explored transforming multiple heterogeneous modalities in microservice systems into a unified language representation through cross-modal transfer.

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction-based anomaly detection relies on the assumption that models trained only on normal data can faithfully reconstruct normal patterns but fail on anomalous regions. However, such models often suffer from the “identity shortcut” problem, where the reconstruction network optimized under reconstruction loss degenerates into an almost identity mapping and reconstructs both normal and anomalous samples equally well. You et al. [ 22 ] provide a systematic analysis of the “identity shortcut” phenomenon and show that commonly used architectures (e.g., MLPs , CNNs, and Transformers) are inherently prone to converging to trivial identity solutions under reconstruction objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 基于重构的异常检测依赖于这样的假设：仅使用正常数据训练的模型能够忠实地重构正常模式，但在异常区域上会失效。 然而，这类模型常常受到「恒等捷径」问题的困扰，即在重构损失下优化的重构网络会退化为近乎恒等的映射，对正常样本和异常样本都能同样好地重构。You 等人 [ 22 ] 对「恒等捷径」现象进行了系统性分析，并表明常用架构（例如多层感知机、卷积神经网络和 Transformer）在重构目标下天然容易收敛到平凡的恒等解。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate the “Identity Shortcut” issue, existing studies introduce additional constraints or training paradigms to regularize the reconstruction process. Structural and semantic instructional information [ 26 , 19 , 20 ] enforce high-level regularities in reconstruction. Memory-based mechanisms [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] constrain reconstruction to learned normal prototypes. Iterative refinement [ 30 ] progressively projects inputs toward the normal data manifold through multiple correction steps. Masking-based reconstruction [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] trains models to infer missing parts of the input. Pseudo-anomaly synthesis [ 21 , 34 , 35 ] augments normal data with synthetic anomalies and enforces recovery of clean samples.
paragraphs.zh: 为了缓解「身份捷径」问题，现有研究引入额外的约束或训练范式来正则化重建过程。 结构和语义的指导信息 [ 26 , 19 , 20 ] 在重建中强制执行高层规律。 基于记忆的机制 [ 27 , 28 , 29 ] 将重建约束到已学习的正常原型上。 迭代细化 [ 30 ] 通过多次校正步骤逐步将输入投影到正常数据流形上。 基于掩码的重建 [ 31 , 32 , 33 ] 训练模型推断输入中缺失的部分。 伪异常合成 [ 21 , 34 , 35 ] 用合成异常增强正常数据，并强制恢复干净样本。

paragraphs.en: Nevertheless, when LLMs are deployed as reconstructors, they remain susceptible to “identity shortcut” due to their immense parameter space and powerful fitting capabilities. In contrast to existing reconstruction-based remedies, our work adopts a prediction-driven autoregressive learning paradigm, which explicitly decouples the input from the reconstruction target through causal modeling, thereby mitigating “identity shortcut” in LLM-based anomaly detection.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当大语言模型被部署为重构器时，由于其庞大的参数空间和强大的拟合能力，它们仍然容易受到“恒等捷径”问题的影响。 与现有的基于重构的补救方法不同，我们的工作采用了一种预测驱动的自回归学习范式，通过因果建模显式地将输入与重构目标解耦，从而在基于大语言模型的异常检测中缓解“恒等捷径”问题。

sents.en: In contrast to existing reconstruction-based remedies, our work adopts a prediction-driven autoregressive learning paradigm, which explicitly decouples the input from the reconstruction target through causal modeling, thereby mitigating “identity shortcut” in LLM-based anomaly detection.

paragraphs.en: Previous anomaly detection approaches are usually based on logs [ 36 , 5 , 37 , 38 ] or metrics [ 39 , 7 , 40 ] , targeting traditional distributed systems without complex invocation relationships. DeepLog [ 36 ] models system logs as sequences of log keys and parameters, learns normal patterns with an LSTM, and detects anomalies via next-event prediction and parameter deviation. Donut [ 41 ] models seasonal KPI time series using a variational autoencoder with missing-data injection and detects anomalies based on reconstruction probability. Recently, some works [ 2 , 6 , 42 ] have begun to use distributed traces for microservice anomaly detection. TraceVAE [ 2 ] employs a dual-variable graph variational autoencoder to encode trace structures and node execution times, and performs anomaly detection using entropy-gap–aware negative log-likelihood scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 以往的异常检测方法通常基于日志[36, 5, 37, 38]或指标[39, 7, 40]，针对的是没有复杂调用关系的传统分布式系统。 DeepLog[36]将系统日志建模为日志键和参数的序列，利用LSTM学习正常模式，并通过下一事件预测和参数偏差来检测异常。 Donut[41]使用带缺失数据注入的变分自编码器对具有季节性的KPI时间序列进行建模，并基于重构概率检测异常。 最近，一些工作[2, 6, 42]开始使用分布式追踪进行微服务异常检测。 TraceVAE[2]采用双变量图变分自编码器对追踪结构和节点执行时间进行编码，并使用熵差感知的负对数似然评分进行异常检测。

paragraphs.en: Although effective within their respective modalities, these approaches can only detect anomalies that manifest in a single modality. Consequently, they fail to capture cross-modal correlations and cascading behaviors across modalities, which are essential for characterizing complex failure patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些方法在其各自的模态内是有效的，但它们只能检测在单一模态中显现的异常。 因此，它们无法捕捉跨模态关联和模态间的级联行为，而这些对于刻画复杂的故障模式至关重要。

sents.zh: 尽管这些方法在其各自的模态内是有效的，但它们只能检测在单一模态中显现的异常。

sents.en: Consequently, they fail to capture cross-modal correlations and cascading behaviors across modalities, which are essential for characterizing complex failure patterns.
sents.zh: 因此，它们无法捕捉跨模态关联和模态间的级联行为，而这些对于刻画复杂的故障模式至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Graph-based methods [ 10 , 15 , 9 , 16 , 8 , 11 , 43 ] organize multimodal data into unified graph structures. MSTGAD [ 16 ] constructs a trace-centric graph backbone and incorporates metrics and logs as node-level features. AnoFusion [ 15 ] treats embedding channels from different modalities as graph nodes and estimates edge weights using mutual information. Other studies [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 17 , 18 ] adopt feature-level fusion strategies. Hades [ 12 ] employs modality-specific feature extractors, Transformers for logs and CNNs for metrics, and subsequently fuses the extracted representations with cross-modality attention. FUSION [ 17 ] fuses serialized multimodal data in the wavelet domain and performs probabilistic spatiotemporal modeling with a diffusion network for anomaly detection.
paragraphs.zh: 基于图的方法 [10, 15, 9, 16, 8, 11, 43] 将多模态数据组织成统一的图结构。 MSTGAD [16] 构建了以轨迹为中心的图主干，并将指标和日志作为节点级特征纳入其中。 AnoFusion [15] 将来自不同模态的嵌入通道视为图节点，并使用互信息估计边权重。 其他研究 [12, 13, 14, 17, 18] 采用特征级融合策略。 Hades [12] 采用特定于模态的特征提取器，即对日志使用 Transformer、对指标使用卷积神经网络（CNN），随后通过跨模态注意力机制融合提取到的表示。 FUSION [17] 在小波域中融合序列化的多模态数据，并利用扩散网络进行概率时空建模以实现异常检测。

paragraphs.en: However, a prevailing limitation across these methodologies is their singular focus on generating a holistic system representation for anomaly detection. By prioritizing an integrated global state, these models fail to sufficiently scrutinize the distinct information inherent to each modality. As a result, anomalies that manifest dominantly in a single modality or exhibit modality-specific signatures may be insufficiently represented in the fused features, which can ultimately limit detection robustness in complex microservice systems.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这些方法普遍存在的局限在于它们仅专注于生成用于异常检测的整体系统表示。 由于优先考虑集成的全局状态，这些模型未能充分审视每种模态所固有的独特信息。 因此，主要在单一模态中显现或表现出模态特定特征的异常，可能在融合特征中得不到充分体现，这最终会限制在复杂微服务系统中检测的鲁棒性。

sents.en: As a result, anomalies that manifest dominantly in a single modality or exhibit modality-specific signatures may be insufficiently represented in the fused features, which can ultimately limit detection robustness in complex microservice systems.

paragraphs.en: For common metric collection systems, such as Prometheus 1 1 1 https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus , metric data are typically sampled at fixed intervals (e.g., every 1 s, 30 s, or 1 min). paragraphs.en: To comprehensively assess the anomaly detection accuracy of LLMMAD in microservice systems, we compare it against a diverse set of unimodal and multimodal baselines. For the sake of fairness, we only select unsupervised methods as the baseline. The unimodal baselines consist of log-based method LogAnomaly [ 5 ] , metric-based method AnomalyTransformer [ 40 ] , and trace-based method TraceAnomaly [ 6 ] . We also opt for several recent multimodal approaches SCWarn [ 18 ] , Triple [ 9 ] , Deeptralog [ 11 ] , and FUSION [ 17 ] that integrate two or more modalities of data.
paragraphs.zh: 为了全面评估LLMMAD在微服务系统中的异常检测准确率，我们将其与多种单模态和多模态基线方法进行比较。 为了保证公平性，我们只选择无监督方法作为基线。 单模态基线包括基于日志的方法LogAnomaly [ 5 ]、基于指标的方法AnomalyTransformer [ 40 ]以及基于调用链的方法TraceAnomaly [ 6 ]。 我们还选择了几种近期的多模态方法，即整合两种或更多数据模态的SCWarn [ 18 ]、Triple [ 9 ]、Deeptralog [ 11 ]和FUSION [ 17 ]。

paragraphs.en: Table IV presents a comprehensive comparison across three standard metrics, including precision (P), recall (R), and F1-score (F1). paragraphs.zh: 当 LoRA 被禁用时，骨干 LLM 保持完全冻结。 尽管性能有所下降，模型仍然表现出不容忽视的异常检测能力，这表明预训练的 LLM 具有固有的时序建模能力。 在这种设置下，精确率始终高于召回率，说明冻结的 LLM 只能识别出一个有限的显著异常子集。 这一对比进一步表明，通过 LoRA 引入少量可训练参数对于有效地将 LLM 适配到多模态异常检测而言既是充分的，也是必要的。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the OR-logic aggregation strategy with majority voting causes a dramatic decrease in recall. Although precision is slightly improved, the overall F1-score drops significantly, indicating that the voting-based scheme is overly conservative and leads to a large number of missed anomalies. This observation also suggests that failures in microservice systems often manifest in only a single modality, rather than simultaneously across multiple modalities, making the OR-logic aggregation strategy more effective in balancing false positives and false negatives. This conclusion further demonstrates the necessity of modeling modality-specific information.
paragraphs.zh: 用多数投票替换 OR 逻辑聚合策略会导致召回率大幅下降。 尽管精确率略有提升，但整体 F1 分数显著下降，这表明基于投票的方案过于保守，导致大量异常被漏检。 这一观察还表明，微服务系统中的故障往往只在单一模态上表现出来，而不是同时在多个模态上出现，这使得 OR 逻辑聚合策略在平衡误报与漏报方面更为有效。 这一结论进一步证明了对模态特定信息进行建模的必要性。

paragraphs.en: The results of comparison between LLMs are summarized in Table VII . It is observed that all evaluated LLMs exhibit a certain level of anomaly detection capability. paragraphs.en: Fig. 8 (b) shows the impact of the partition ratio γ \gamma on detection performance. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose LLMMAD, an unsupervised framework that leverages LLMs for multimodal anomaly detection in microservice systems. To reconcile cross-modal interaction with modality-specific detail preservation, LLMMAD adopts a hybrid fusion-decoupling paradigm, in which multimodal embeddings are interleaved for unified LLM processing, while modality-wise reconstruction heads preserve modality-specific anomaly cues. Moreover, to address the “identity shortcut” issue in reconstruction-based methods, LLMMAD employs a prediction-driven autoregressive objective that forces the model to infer future states from historical context rather than trivially copying inputs, thereby yielding more discriminative anomaly representations. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that LLMMAD consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches. Overall, this work not only provides a reliable solution for automated microservice anomaly detection.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 LLMMAD，一个利用大语言模型（LLM）在微服务系统中进行多模态异常检测的无监督框架。 为了兼顾跨模态交互与模态特定细节的保留，LLMMAD 采用了一种混合的融合-解耦范式，其中多模态嵌入被交错排列以供 LLM 统一处理，同时各模态的重构头保留模态特定的异常线索。 此外，为了解决基于重构方法中的「恒等捷径」问题，LLMMAD 采用预测驱动的自回归目标，迫使模型从历史上下文推断未来状态，而非简单地复制输入，从而产生更具判别性的异常表示。 在三个真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，LLMMAD 持续优于当前最先进的方法。 总体而言，这项工作不仅为微服务自动化异常检测提供了一种可靠的解决方案。
